SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_GladEveryoneIsRefre.en: I'm glad to see that everyone is\nlooking refreshed and chipper.
SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_GladEveryoneIsRefre.fr: Contente de voir que tout le monde\nva bien.

SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyB.en: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little brother…
SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyB.fr: Oh, désolée de t'embêter. Mais tu\nressembles à mon petit frère.

SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyS.en: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little sister…
SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyS.fr: Oh, désolée de t'embêter. Mais tu\nressembles à ma petite sœur.

SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_TakeAShortRest.en: You look tired. Would you like to\ntake a short rest?
SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_TakeAShortRest.fr: Tu as fait un long voyage, non ? Tu\nveux te reposer un moment ?
